name: 関連語と操作を重ねる画像検索
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
LH01-0066 correction using ORIGINAL input1 as the immutable photo base. Preserve the original exact1038x1271 image/crop/tilt, cardigan stitches, lace embroidery, skirt folds, skin, bag strap, floor and door pixels. Do not redraw, denoise, smooth, sharpen, enhance or reconstruct the photograph. Original softness is intentional. Input2 failed version is only a defect reference: it reconstructed/smoothed textile detail; do not use that photo.
Edit only the THREE existing white chip text regions to Japanese: 自然な装い / カーディガン / 落ち着いた色, Meiryo Regular40014/24, tracking0. Keep original full chip bounds/coverage and source photo hidden behind them. Change ONLY original black primary circle fill to forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E; keep its original white open-lens+sparkle glyph pixels. Preserve source white secondary circles, source share-tray arrow and outlined diagonal pin geometry; recolor only these glyph pixels to slate#526173.
No style reference is supplied this pass. No changes outside original UI overlay masks; no new layout, texture, image detail or content. Purewhite external canvas. This is localized text/fill/glyph-color editing of original, not a recreation of the clothing photograph.
reviewNotes: Removing style input and restricting original overlays still reconstructs/smooths protected knit, lace and embroidery detail. Japanese keywords, original action anatomy and green primary remain present. Exact photo preservation unmet after two attempts; retain both versions pending, with no owner acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
